calls.title: Review of work to date
calls.summary: The meeting centered on optimizing BDR campaign initiatives focusing on targeted outbound strategies rather than broad experimentation. Key figures like Matthew Du Pont highlighted the importance of refining existing efforts, with significant tracking showing 112 hours devoted since January. The team identified Proto Enterprise and Rio signals as promising leads and plans to pursue OSS signals and former Growth Book customers. Event outreach revealed potential in engaging local DevOps meetups, while AI-driven content generation was emphasized for improving message drafting and workflow. Additionally, the strategy for transitioning to usage-based pricing for new customers was discussed, alongside market targeting for companies with high web traffic to enhance win rates. Overall, the focus is on maximizing effectiveness in BDR efforts and strategic pricing to support revenue growth.
calls.keywords: AI-driven outreach, BDR productivity, former GrowthBook users, account-based marketing, event-based campaigns, usage-based pricing
